scope: robot contact skills for the existing FR3 A/B1/B2 runtime; declarative recommendations, not a new task executor

states.name: 工具与箱体分离
states.definition: Fresh camera and both TCPs geometrically separated; fusion also requires low wrist load.

states.name: 双臂侧接触、箱体受支撑
states.definition: Opposed side loads with loaded-FK center at the known support plane.

states.name: 双臂悬空搬运
states.definition: Both wrists bear vertical payload; a camera view is not required.

states.name: 左臂接触、桌面推送
states.definition: Loaded front TCP implies supported Cube away from the rear contact band.

states.name: 左臂接触、后墙约束
states.definition: Loaded front TCP implies rear-wall contact within the declared geometry band.

states.name: 双臂接触、后墙约束
states.definition: Loaded front and right-side TCPs with rear-wall constraint; motion is a separate feature.

states.name: 双臂接触、双墙约束
states.definition: Loaded front and side contacts imply rear and side wall constraints.

states.name: 角落工具撤离
states.definition: Both TCPs separate from the fresh visual Cube box in the coarse corner zone.

states.name: 证据不足
states.definition: Do not infer contact or continue a skill from missing observations.

states.name: 传感器冲突或超载
states.definition: Loaded contact geometry conflicts or raw wrench exceeds the baseline envelope.

inputs: camera RGB/ArUco position at receive time
encoder-FK TCP positions and inward cup normals
limitations: Wrist unloading does not prove geometric separation.
Force-loaded TCP center assumes an aligned flat Cube face and configured Cube size.
Vision-only proximity cannot prove force-bearing contact.
Static scene geometry is a prior, not measured Cube truth.
This baseline is not a learned multi-source fusion model or real-suction validation.

skills.name: 侧吸对准
skills.success: Loaded opposed side contacts at support height
skills.abort: Unexpected contact, invalid geometry or overload

skills.name: 建立双臂连接代理

control.method: temporary bilateral fixed joints; no real suction claim

skills.success: Settled grasp geometry and finite wrist feedback
skills.abort: TCP grasp error > 2 mm or Cube drift > 15 mm

skills.name: 同步双臂搬运

control.method: shared Cartesian translation with paired position/velocity commands

skills.success: Both wrists bear suspended payload; endpoint and collision guards pass
skills.abort: Individual force > 30 N, TCP moment > 3 Nm, opposing force > 15 N, or collision

skills.name: 落地并释放代理

control.method: lower along synchronized path; remove fixed proxies; retract

skills.success: Supported landing and no significant residual wrist load
skills.abort: Landing error > 15 mm, collision or force-envelope failure

skills.name: 左臂桌面推送

control.method: front face normal aligned with +Y; collision-checked push

skills.success: Front normal load and rear-wall geometry evidence
skills.abort: Individual force > 30 N, TCP moment > 3 Nm or unexpected contact

skills.name: 后墙压紧保持
skills.success: Sustained front normal load in rear-wall geometry band
skills.abort: Force > 10 N, TCP moment > 1 Nm, preload timeout or contact loss

skills.name: 右臂在吸附高度平面对准

control.method: lift; rail transfer; descend at stand-off; approach horizontally

skills.success: Right cup normal aligned with -X before side contact
skills.abort: Unexpected contact, left-hold loss or force-envelope violation

skills.name: 双臂协同沿后墙推入

control.method: 15 s synchronized Cartesian quintic with live left preload

skills.success: Loaded rear and side constraints; corner geometry and settling pass
skills.abort: Force > 10 N, TCP moment > 1 Nm, support dropout > 0.05 s or unexpected contact

skills.name: 顺序卸载与撤离

control.method: right unload/retreat while left holds, then left unload/retreat

skills.success: Both TCPs retracted; load removed; visual corner observation when available
skills.abort: Force > 10 N, TCP moment > 1 Nm, inward retreat > 20 um or settling failure

skills.name: 保持并重新观测

control.method: observation recommendation only; never automatically continue after overload

skills.success: Fresh consistent evidence or explicit operator recovery
skills.abort: Persistent inconsistent/overload evidence requires stopped-task recovery
